title: Investigating the Aryl Hydrocarbon Receptor Agonist/Antagonist Conformational Switch Using Well-Tempered Metadynamics Simulations.
authors: Mosa, Farag E S; AlRawashdeh, Sara; El-Kadi, Ayman O S; Barakat, Khaled
journal: Journal of chemical information and modeling
one_liner_zh: 该文用AI结构预测和Well-Tempered Metadynamics模拟研究芳香烃受体（AhR）转录因子配体结合构象开关，虽聚焦TF构象动态而非直接DNA互作，但方法可迁移至TF-DNA结合机制研究。
abstract: The aryl hydrocarbon receptor (AhR) is a ligand-dependent transcription factor that mediates biological signals to control various complicated cellular functions. It plays a crucial role in environmental sensing and xenobiotic metabolism. Dysregulation of AhR is associated with health concerns, including cancer and immune system disorders. Upon binding to AhR ligands, AhR, along with heat shock protein 90 and other partner proteins undergoes a transformation in the nucleus, heterodimerizes with the aryl hydrocarbon receptor nuclear translocator (ARNT), and mediates numerous biological functions by inducing the transcription of various AhR-responsive genes. In this manuscript, the 3-dimensional structure of the entire human AhR is obtained using an artificial intelligence tool, and molecular dynamics (MD) simulations are performed to study different structural conformations. These conformations provide insights into the protein's function and movement in response to ligand binding. Understanding the dynamic behavior of AhR will contribute to the development of targeted therapies for associated health conditions. Therefore, we employ well-tempered metadynamics (WTE-metaD) simulations to explore the conformational landscape of AhR and obtain a better understanding of its functional behavior. Our computational results are in excellent agreement with previous experimental findings, revealing the closed and open states of helix alpha1 in the basic helix-loop-helix (bHLH domain) in the cytoplasm at the atomic level. We also predict the inactive form of AhR and identify Arginine 42 as a key residue that regulates switching between closed and open conformations in existing AhR modulators.
abstract_zh: 芳香烃受体（AhR）是一种配体依赖性转录因子，介导生物信号以调控多种复杂的细胞功能。它在环境感知和外源物代谢中发挥关键作用。AhR的失调与健康问题相关，包括癌症和免疫系统疾病。当与AhR配体结合后，AhR与热休克蛋白90及其他伴侣蛋白一起在细胞核中发生构象转变，与芳香烃受体核转位蛋白（ARNT）形成异二聚体，并通过诱导多种AhR响应基因的转录来介导众多生物学功能。在本手稿中，利用人工智能工具获得了整个人类AhR的三维结构，并进行分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟以研究不同的结构构象。这些构象为蛋白质在配体结合时的功能与运动提供了见解。理解AhR的动态行为将有助于开发针对相关健康状况的靶向疗法。因此，我们采用温和元动力学（well-tempered metadynamics, WTE-metaD）模拟来探索AhR的构象景观，并更深入地理解其功能行为。我们的计算结果与先前的实验发现高度一致，在原子水平上揭示了细胞质中碱性螺旋-环-螺旋（basic helix-loop-helix, bHLH结构域）内螺旋α1的闭合和开放状态。我们还预测了AhR的非活性形式，并识别出精氨酸42为关键残基，调控现有AhR调节剂中闭合与开放构象之间的切换。
